findings.message: `refresh` always shows the `Start drain` and `Start serve` buttons, even when it has just found the engine running (`ping.engine && snap.engine`). Criterion 1 requires `clutch_engine_start` calls to be admission-gated. The canonical surface gates them on liveness: `vscode-clutchwork/package.json` lines 561/566 show the play actions only when `!clutch.engineRunning`, set from `snap.engine` in `extension.js:122`. The app lets a second start fire against a running engine. The harness at `tests/mcp_app_dashboard.js:36` clicks `Start drain` while its fake ping returns `engine: true`, so it pins the ungated behavior.
findings.paved_road: Append the `Start drain` / `Start serve` buttons only when the computed liveness is false, reusing the same `ping.engine && snap.engine` value. In the harness, assert that the start buttons are absent while the engine is running, then make the fake ping/snapshot report the engine stopped, refresh, and click `Start drain`.

findings.message: `refresh` always shows the `Stop` button, even when liveness says the engine is stopped. Criterion 1 requires `clutch_engine_control` calls to be admission-gated. The canonical stop action is shown only when `clutch.engineRunning` is true (`vscode-clutchwork/package.json:571`). The harness never checks that `Stop` is hidden while the engine is stopped.
findings.paved_road: Append `Stop` only when the computed liveness is true. Add a harness assertion that `Stop` is absent after a refresh where the fake ping reports `engine: false`, and present and calling `clutch_engine_control` with `action: "stop"` when it reports `engine: true`.
